seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [arm] show mixed outcomes: y x9, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring/beam move vertically as one (A1/A2 +/-6): blocks overlapping the beam are carried, blocks hit by moved rects are pushed in a chain.
Hypothesis resolved: block A1 no_change (t38) = beam pushes blocks to y=1 < min 2, so the whole vertical move is cancelled; it is not a field of the block.
A4/A3 change beam w by 6 (1..43). A hooked next/collected block (x == beam end-5) drags all on-beam blocks; otherwise extension pushes swept blocks.
If a group is blocked (x>48 or into the ring), the beam changes alone. Clicks and A5/A7 do nothing. Stateless, 45/45.
Unconfirmed: collection order (next = rightmost todo), the ring's vertical bounds, block max y 58.
